typography.pixel_font_license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (embedded in demo)
rules: Pixel face is used for hierarchy only: h1, h2, brand, stat-value, navitem, btn, tabs, employee-name, thread-name, column-head, theme-option
Pixel face is NEVER used for long-form content
Arabic (lang=ar) keeps the readable sans face — pixel face is suppressed
Headings in EN pixel face: weight 500, letter-spacing 0
Overrides: brand 17px, employee-name 16px, thread-name 15px, h2 18px, dialog h2 23px, sectionhead h2 16px, btn/tabs/navitem 13px, btn.small 12px
No movement, glow or brightness jumps in the pixel skin
Active states use inset shadow, not transform (pixel skin)
prefers-reduced-motion disables all transitions and animations

shell.mobile: <=800px: sidebar becomes a drawer with .nav-scrim; rail toggle hidden

surfaces.panel: border 1px soft, background surface, radius per theme, plus stepped frame in pixel skin
surfaces.board: 4 columns (min 0), cards with title, meta, progress meter
surfaces.chat: 240px threads + flexible main; log height 490px scroll; composer pinned
surfaces.settings: 2fr / 1fr split; setting rows with label, description and a 170px control

atoms.avatar_art: 65 pixel portraits, 48x48 grid SVG paths traced from Characters.jpeg (rows x columns)
atoms.badges: working/sent/done -> accent; error/failed/critical -> danger; paused/high/approval -> warning
atoms.meter: 2-4px bar; discrete accent blocks (6px on, 2px off) in pixel skin

i18n.direction: dir switches to rtl for ar; all layout uses logical properties
i18n.arabic_typeface: readable sans (Arial/Tahoma) — pixel face suppressed for ar
bilingual_artifacts: skip link 'Skip to content / تجاوز إلى المحتوى'
data strings stored as [en, ar] pairs
bdi and dir=auto for mixed content
i18n.number_and_currency: num() and money() helpers localise digits/currency

accessibility_contract: Native <dialog> showModal for focus containment + inert background
aria-labelledby on dialogs, role=status/live regions for announcements
Visible 2px accent focus ring with 3px offset on all interactive elements
48px minimum touch targets on coarse pointers
forced-colors: panels get CanvasText borders, pixel icons use CanvasText
aria-current / aria-selected / aria-pressed used for state, not colour alone

avatars.format: inline SVG paths, one path per row-run (e.g. M12 15h1v1h-1z)
avatars.render: image-rendering:pixelated; 2px 2px 0 var(--soft) offset shadow in the skin
avatars.note: two grids: pixel density differs at equal render size - normalise or render the 32-grid at half size

palette_system.mechanism: PALETTES object -> applyPalette() sets data-palette + inline custom properties per theme; no CSS nth-child tricks
palette_system.custom_accent: hex input + colour picker, pattern #[0-9a-fA-F]{6}, automatically contrast-adjusted, reports 'Adjusted for contrast: #...'
palette_system.restore: Restore original colors action resets to sage + #accab3

states.preview: Settings -> Demo states: choose workspace + state, then Preview

breakpoints.800: sidebar becomes a drawer with scrim; mobile nav button visible
